ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear that you are feeling disappointed with your grill. We understand your disappointment and we would like to offer some tips to help you get the best experience from your grill. 

If your grill is located in a coastal or humid area or if chlorine is present in your environment additional maintenance will be needed to prevent rust and keep up the appearance of the exterior stainless steel parts. Below are a couple of helpful tips:

1.  At the first sign of exterior staining, discoloration, or surface rust we recommend cleaning with a stainless steel cleaner, such as Noxon 7 to remove the rust, followed by stainless steel polish to preserve the shine. Continue to use the stainless steel polish periodically to keep your grill looking its best.

2.  Once a week we recommend wiping down the grill with a wet towel or rag and then drying completely.  This will remove any harmful salt or chemicals from the grill’s exterior.

3.  We suggest only covering your grill in the event of inclement weather. This will help prevent accelerated corrosion on the interior parts of your grill as well. 

Regarding your interior grill parts, I'd also like to note that The Flavorizer bars will develop surface corrosion due to their exposure to high heat and food drippings. They don’t need to be replaced unless they have holes or cracks in them.

Of course, your grill has a generous warranty and the Weber Support team is always here to help. Please look for our email outreach as we want to make sure you have everything you need.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText:
I purchased this grill to replace a Sears stainless steel model l had for about 6 years.  On its exterior the grill almost  looked new but the inside firebox was rusted out to the point it was unsafe.

So when l started looking l began researching top rated grills.  I was especially concerned with durability,  quality build materials,  and quality construction.   Interestingly while in a major retailer looking at several models a random gentleman approached me and highly endorsed Genesis grills, stating he had a slightly older model than the one l was considering and that it was by far the best grill he'd ever owned.  So l ended up buying the Spirit E-310.  I've now used it several times and enjoyed its ease, convenience, and reliability.   l also have an egg-like charcoal grill that has served me well, so between the two l am ready for any type of cooking.
Results.Title: If You're in the Spirit

46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
